use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

let width = 6
let height = 4
let random = Random(4)

let cells = (0..width * height) |> collect_list()

let mines =
    SET[int](
        cells
            |> map(cell => (cell, random.next()))
            |> sort((a, b) => a.`1 <> b.`1)
            |> map(pair => pair.`0)
            |> take(random.next(3, 5)))

let cleared = SET[int]()
let marked = SET[int]()

neighbours(cell: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let (x, y) = (cell % width, cell / width)

    for dy in -1::1 do
        for dx in -1::1 do
            let (nx, ny) = (x + dx, y + dy)

            let on_grid = nx >= 0 /\ nx < width /\ ny >= 0 /\ ny < height

            if (dx != 0 \/ dy != 0) /\ on_grid then
                yield ny * width + nx
            fi
        od
    od
si

    neighbours(cell) |> filter(n => mines.contains(n)) |> count()

clear(cell: int) is
    if cleared.contains(cell) \/ marked.contains(cell) then
        return
    fi

    cleared.add(cell)

    if adjacent_mines(cell) == 0 then
        for n in neighbours(cell) |> collect_list() do
            clear(n)
        od
    fi
si

symbol(cell: int, reveal: bool) -> string =>
    if reveal /\ mines.contains(cell) then "*"
    elif marked.contains(cell) then "?"
    elif !cleared.contains(cell) then "."
    elif adjacent_mines(cell) == 0 then " "
    else "{adjacent_mines(cell)}"
    fi

show(reveal: bool) is
    for y in 0..height do
        write_line(
            (0..width)
                |> map(x => symbol(y * width + x, reveal))
                |> join(""))
    od
si

write_line("there are {mines.count} mines")
write_line("enter 'c x y' to clear a square or 'm x y' to mark one")
show(false)

let finished mut = false

while !finished do
    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        break
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")

    let parts = line.split([' '])
    let (x, y) = (int.parse(parts[1]) - 1, int.parse(parts[2]) - 1)
    let cell = y * width + x

    if parts[0] =~ "m" then
        if !marked.remove(cell) then
            marked.add(cell)
        fi
    elif mines.contains(cell) then
        write_line("that was a mine")
        show(true)
        finished = true
        continue
    else
        clear(cell)
    fi

    show(false)

    if marked.set_equals(mines) then
        write_line("all mines found")
        finished = true
    fi
